features:
🎯 Aimbot & Triggerbot Modes: Professional multi-mode target locking system designed for absolute dominance. Features an independent Triggerbot with a customizable delay slider, alongside a mutually exclusive 3-mode Aimbot suite (Rage for instant snapping, Ultra Legit (AI) for organic human-like tracing, and SmoothLegit for balanced precision) ensuring only one mode runs at a time.

⭕ FOV Circle & Targeting Controls: Built-in dynamic Field of View (FOV) circle with customizable radius scaling and visibility toggles. Includes strict Wall Check validation to prevent locking through solid objects, robust Team Check to safeguard allies, and a max distance slider for optimized target prioritization.

👀 ESP Visuals & Instant Cleanup: Comprehensive player and NPC tracking suite featuring a master toggle and custom Team Check filtering. Includes real-time 2D bounding boxes, dynamic health bars, distance markers, and custom name tags. Built with an ultra-fast ragdoll/death cleanup engine that instantly wipes drawings the microsecond a target dies.

📷 Camera & World Settings: Custom Field of View (FOV) slider to expand your perspective. Includes powerful world utilities such as Fullbright to clear out dark areas and shadows, and a No Fog toggle for crystal-clear long-range visibility.

🛠️ Misc & Menu Utilities: Quality-of-life additions including a Local Skin Changer to customize weapon materials, a No Recoil utility, and a customizable Menu Keybind button (default: Insert) to instantly hide or show your animated glassmorphic interface.
